text:
ReleaseManager: heads-up — starting our 22:00 UTC change window for release v2.18.0. rolling deployment will begin now. I'll be the coordinator.

deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff: release=v2.18.0, job=rolling-update, regions=[us-east-1], strategy=canary->ramp, change_window=2026-03-21T22:00Z

oncall-ola: I'm on SLO dashboards (link: https://dashboards.internal/slo/release-v2.18.0). Alert thresholds: p95 > 220ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 2m => hold.

ryan: Callout: also watch embed-service errors and KV cache hit rate. If KV hit < 70% for 5m, consider reverting quantization-config.

sre-anna: Adding a short-term traffic guard: freeze route weight > 20% until we see stable metrics for 10m. Running preflight healthcheck now:
```
curl -sS https://health.redwood.internal/v2/ping || exit 1
```

qa-liz: smoke tests running against canary (quick generation + embeddings + auth flows). Will post pass/fail.

oncall-ola: p50=120ms, p95=185ms, 5xx=0.02% — initial looks good.

qa-liz: smoke: generation ok, embeddings ok, long-prompt smoke (100 samples) all passed. tagging the results.

sre-anna: Deploybot note: rolling-update instance-3 failed healthcheck (startup timeout). Auto-retry queued (1/3).

deploy-bot: auto-retry: instance-3 (attempt 1) — restarting container

ReleaseManager: keep an eye. If retries exceed 2, we prepare rollback plan and pin traffic to v2.17.9.

oncall-ola: Retry succeeded. instance-3 back in. p95 moved to 205ms briefly then settled. No increase in 5xx. :thumbsup:

ryan: small functional flake from prompt-group-B (timeout @ 7s) — re-run isolated tests. Don't ramp beyond 50% until QA confirms.

qa-liz: re-run passed (timeout was infra noise). marking as resolved.

sre-anna: Observability alert: error budget burn up to 0.6% over last 10m (threshold 0.5%). I'm pausing ramp at 50% and pinning traffic. Investigating logs — seeing 500 spikes correlated to embed-service batch_size=64.

ReleaseManager: pause acknowledged. Notifying teams and creating incident channel for triage. rollback remains on standby; decision window = 15m.

oncall-ola: created #inc/req-2754321999-triage for deeper investigation.

ryan: I can prepare rollback command and notes, but let's attempt a config tweak first: lower embed-service batch_size to 32 on canary.

sre-anna: Applying change to canary: batch_size=32 -> scaling now.

deploy-bot: config update applied to embed-service-canary (batch_size=32).

oncall-ola: post-change metrics: p95 => 210ms, 5xx trending down to 0.3%. KV cache hit steady at 76%.

ReleaseManager: good. resume ramp to 75% with continued monitoring. Keep guardrails in place for 30m. If any threshold re-tripped, rollback immediately.

qa-liz: full test suite pass on canary and 75% traffic.

ryan: plan to finish ramp to 100% in 10m if stable. Will note the config tweak in release notes.

sre-anna: keeping freeze rule and extra tracing for 30m. Removing automatic retry escalation.

ReleaseManager: nice work. Saving this thread for post-deploy summary and release notes (include: embed-service batch_size rollback->32, transient instance-3 health flake, QA flake resolved). Closing coordination unless something else pops up. :sparkles:
